title: Cauchy–Schwarz bound as a product of norms
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $k>0$, and let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ to each $s\in\mathbb F_2^k$. The recursively defined Cauchy–Schwarz bound for $F$ at level $k$ equals $\prod_{s\in\mathbb F_2^k}\|F(s)\|_{U^k}$, where $\|f\|_{U^k}$ is the $2^k$-th root of the diagonal Gowers inner product of order $k$ of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a family of real-valued functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$, indexed by $\mathbb F_2^k$
